source: User supplied Lavender growth reference, 1774 x 887

stages.Sprout: Two broad oval sage cotyledons on a short stem
stages.Young: Three basal branches with narrow, fleshy sage leaves
stages.BudForming: Dense narrow foliage and five tall purple bud heads
stages.Ready: Nine staggered outward-fanning stems; plump purple florets in stacked whorls
stages.Harvest: Three cut sprigs together and one separate sprig with sparse narrow leaves

geometry: Closed curved leaf lenses in varied radial directions; physical florets distributed around the spike, no billboard foliage
palette: Reference gray-sage foliage with clear highlights, rich purple and lilac florets, brown seeds
